We scored sentence pairs by multiple metrics that were used as hallucination detectors in previous works. Specifically, we used some methods from : ChrF++ , reference-based COMET and referenceless COMET-QE , and Seq-Logprob (their best detector). We also used some methods introduced in : cosine similarity coming from LASER3  and LaBSE , a bidirectional XNLI score, and ALTI+ source contributions .
For annotation, we choose professional translators (2 for each language) who are allowed to annotate our data only after passing a specifically developed qualification test.
